results.title: MAGA Knives Out for TV Star Tipped to Replace Karoline Leavitt
results.description: Scott Olson / Getty Images MAGA diehards are trying to torpedo Scott Jennings’ apparent bid to replace Karoline Leavitt as President Donald Trump’s press secretary, according to a new report. The MAGA pundit, 48, is the current frontrunner for the job, the Daily Beast reported earlier this week, and he has been secretly meeting with Trump’s chief of staff, Susie Wiles, to discuss taking on the role, according to the Daily Mail . Jennings has staged several media stunts that appear to be informal auditions for the job, including coming out swinging for Trump’s assistant Natalie Harp , calling Democratic Sen. Jon Ossoff a “sucker punching coward” after he name-dropped her in an attack on Trump. Read more at The Daily Beast.

results.title: Quote of the day by Emma Watson, 'All I can do is follow my instincts, because I'll never please everyone' shows psychology of confident, unapologetic person, offers wisdom self-belief, confidence, identity, self-worth
results.description: Quote of the day by Emma Watson provides a timeless reminder about authenticity, confidence, and the importance of trusting yourself. No matter how carefully you live, someone will eventually disagree with a decision you make. Attempting to avoid all criticism can lead to a life shaped more by other people’s expectations than by your own values. A healthier approach is to listen thoughtfully, learn continuously, consider consequences, and then have the courage to choose a direction that feels right for you.
